exposure: initiation of antiretroviral therapy in the third trimester
plasma viral load 500 copies/mL or greater
delivery between 37 and 40 weeks of gestation
HIV-indicated cesarean delivery vs other indications
cohort: 6,444 pregnant women with HIV infection in the United States
finding: The study found that while almost 50% of pregnant women with HIV infection underwent cesarean delivery, the rate of repeat cesarean deliveries increased over time, whereas the rate of HIV-indicated cesarean deliveries decreased.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were more likely to be performed in women at high risk of mother-to-child transmission.
